name: CATS semantic editorial model

navigationModel.partOpenings: one dedicated opening page per part
navigationModel.chapters: 34 unique chapter entries, each assigned to exactly one part
navigationModel.supplementarySections: chapter-zero sections after the numbered chapters
navigationModel.toc: hierarchical Part > Chapter/Supplementary Section without duplicate chapter entries

taxonomyNormalizationRule: Source taxonomy is immutable. A dedicated part-opening page that carries the previous chapter number receives editorial.chapter=0 while source chapter metadata remains unchanged.
wave2Rule: No source title, paragraph, source part, source chapter, or source ordering may be rewritten, merged, deleted, or reordered while normalizing editorial taxonomy and navigation.
